question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party and state institutions through mid-2026, with loyalists dominating the Politburo Standing Committee and no designated successor in place ahead of the 21st Party Congress expected in autumn 2027. Analysts highlight the absence of elite defections, visible factional struggles, or military challenges capable of forcing removal before the December 2026 market deadline, despite periodic PLA personnel shifts. Trader consensus at 95.3% for "No" reflects this structural continuity and Xi's ongoing public role in diplomacy and appointments. Low-probability shifts could still arise from an abrupt health event, sudden internal fracture, or unforeseen leadership crisis.
